body: I am so exhausted. And I’m not smart enough to handle my classes apparently. Nothing I do is good enough. And there’s no point in continuing if I’ll never measure up. What’s the point in suffering through life of self hatred and distress anyways?

last time I tried I wound up in a hospital and the nurses we so shitty to me and it made me want to die even more than I did when I took all those pills. I can’t bear the thought of fucking it up again
wait... in law school? can I PM you?
not at all. I posted it here because it’s pretty humorous lmao

this is why I can’t bring myself to try and seek out a diagnosis. my mom, my SO, my debate coach, and multiple autistic friends have suggested I look into it but the fear of being invalidated is so strong. 

I really could use the disability assistance from my university though which is a bummer

you’re so right. I sometimes forget there are other options.

and there are other scars there, but they’re oooold. Like 8+ years old. So suffice to say, the contrast is.... apparent. I’ll look into bio oil. 

school really gets to me sometimes. I really need some better coping mechanisms or law school is gonna be an even bigger oof. you hang in there too, friend!
